details.gpu_style: user-image compact single-fan dual-slot card; fan faces perforated side panel and dual-slot bracket faces rear service panel
details.layout: Mini-ITX enclosure with directly supported dual-slot GPU and compact 1U PSU; no PCIe riser assembly or riser mounting hardware
details.storage: M.2 only; no separate drive bays
details.ventilation: large perforated side panels; no front ventilation
details.front_panel: solid removable magnetic panel with power-button opening only
details.panel_fit: front, rear, left and right panels extend flush between the top cap and base with no exposed inner-frame gaps
details.perimeter_panel_retention: tool-less magnetic retention for front, rear, left and right panels; no perimeter-panel screws
details.magnet_spec: 15 x 10 x 4 mm rectangular countersunk magnet seated in a 15.4 x 10.4 x 4.2 mm shallow flat cut directly into each corner post and retained by one centered M3 x 8 countersunk screw into a 2.6 mm printed pilot; no separate carrier or full enclosure pocket; four stations per perimeter panel, 16 total; adjacent panel heights staggered and rear positions clear all service apertures
details.rear_panel_mounting: magnet stations and locating features must not intrude into motherboard, GPU or PSU service apertures

notes: User removed the GPU riser requirement. The CAD retains direct dual-slot GPU supports (rear bracket frame, tail saddle and side clamps) and the compact 160 x 80 x 40 mm 1U PSU. GPU concept envelope remains 180 x 115 x 40 mm.
